info.title: Sales as a Service tRPC API (unofficial)
info.description: Unofficial description of the tRPC endpoints the salesasaservice.at web app calls. Derived from the client bundles and read-only probes; not published or endorsed by the platform. An account without a finished onboarding gets PRECONDITION_FAILED from workspace procedures; one with a workspace gets the procedure's own answer.
